It counts toward Hockey+ scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections (it's how teams with no standings on the routes build a record of their own).

Across 44 graded Hockey+ games the algo now scales scoring ×0.940 and gives home teams -0.2 goals. Team corrections start after 3 graded games for a team.
